items.title: Cat Maid Cafe
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description:
Let's go to the cafe! I hear they have the cutest cat maids there- all dressed up in cute maid attire, and they wear cat ears! I sure hope they have cake or cookies!

+ 12 HD skins!
+ Cat-themed cuteness!
+ So many cute colours- go meow or go reow!

By Pixel Squared

items.title: Ninjas vs Samurai
items.creator: Loose Screw
items.description:
Battle for honor and glory with Ninjas vs Samurai. Whether you're sneaking through the shadows or charging into battle, these awesome skins will help you look the part!

- Total of 10 skins
- Great for roleplay!
- By Loose Screw

items.title: Bunny Maids
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Hop into a cleaning grove with these cute bunny maids! Roleplay in your house or cafe with your adorable hats and stylish shoes. 

+ Bunny Maids pack with 12 cleaning ready skins! 
+ Perfect for all your friends to share! 
+ Colorful hair! 

By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Cruise Ship
items.creator: Lua Studios
items.description: Set sail for adventure on the Cruise Ship! Explore a massive ship and decorate it with unique furniture. Take to the skies in a helicopter, drive a boat or car, or speed across the water on a jet ski. Role-play with friends and bring your dream vacation to life!

items.title: Weapons Expansion
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Play with new weapons in your survival! They all have unique abilities!
Summon lightning, create firestorms, shoot magic, become invisible and much more!

This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

items.title: Pawsome Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description: Show off your wild side with stylish teen skins featuring fun animal-inspired outfits and cozy vibes.

items.title: Difficulty: Brutal 1.1 Add-On
items.creator: Octovon
items.description:
Experience this extreme add-on that intensifies survival with thirst, limb damage, climate hazards, rotting food, and mobs that grow stronger over time. Food decays, injuries cripple, and biomes shape how you explore and endure.

+ Biomes impact your body temperature!
+ Limbs can now take damage!
+ Food now decays overtime!
+ Mobs get stronger the more days you play!
items.changelog: Update 1.1.0 - New Mob Power Scaling system (hostile mobs get stronger over time) - All systems (Thirst, Limb Damage, Food Spoiling, etc.) can be toggled individually - Expanded support for custom food & armor from other Add-Ons - Configurable UI & improved menus - Balancing, QoL updates & bug fixes

items.title: YOUR NIGHTMARE
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Become the very nightmare that haunts others in the night! Embrace the darkness and uncover the secrets lurking in the shadows!

+Horror skins!
+Amazing for roleplay!

items.title: Autobattler Deluxe
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Strategically place your warriors on the battlefield and let them fight in the arenas of Autobattler Deluxe!

- Singleplayer Campaign with 4 ARENAS
- 20+ units with UNIQUE ABILITIES!
- Multiplayer PvP Battles
- Adjustable difficulty

By Imaginary Trident Studios & Pathway Studios

items.title: SCP
items.creator: Builders Horizon
items.description:
Explore the dark corridors of the SCP underground lab. Use custom weapons to fight 8 mutant SCP creatures, including SCP-106, SCP-173, SCP-511 and SCP-957. Includes 2 lab scientist skins and 4 SCP monster skins! 

CC-BY-SA license

items.title: LUCKY BLOCKS
items.creator: Builders Horizon
items.description: LUCKY BLOCKS DX! With over 100 possibilities, will you be lucky or unlucky? Battle the Unlucky Block Boss and his Minion Block with help from your Lucky Block Buddy! Wield four powerful weapons and armor sets, each with unique abilities! Experience random start areas in every new world!

items.title: Demons
items.creator: Builders Horizon
items.description:
Unleash your inner darkness with Demons! This collection features a variety of unique and devilishly stylish characters, bringing the mysterious charm of demons to life.
+12 Demon inspired skins

items.title: White Furniture
items.creator: Eescal Studios
items.description:
White Furniture offers simple and elegant designs, perfect for standalone houses. Decorate your spaces with ease and add a cozy touch to your builds. Ideal for role-playing and creating a warm, inviting home atmosphere.

+ Custom tools
+ Animations

items.title: Cottage Bunny Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Be a cute little bunny frolicing through the forest and picking mushrooms with this adorable skin pack. Choose from a variety of cottage core fashion styles!

+ 12 skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Food Expansion
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Bring you an extensive collection of delicious new foods, powerful cooking tools, and unique recipes to master.

- New Food Recipee
- New Kitchen Table
- New Crops
- New Farm Utility Vehicles
- New Entites
- and Much More

Become the ultimate food master and turn your survival experience into a gourmet journey with Food Expansion addon
items.changelog:
- New Armor Set: 
Miner Helmet (Night Vision)
Cropwind Chestplate (Jump Boost)
Forager Pants (Auto Collect)
Boots of Travel (Speed)

- Merchant sells Crystal Candy
- Vending Machine sells Milk Bucket
- Crop plot recipes for all seeds

items.title: Monster Fruit
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Indulge in the dark and creepy world of Monster Fruit! These colorful fruits are not for the faint of heart, as they are beloved by evil creatures and hungry monsters alike. Experience a taste of horror as you eat these scary and delicious treats. Or perhaps they eat you...

- 10 HD skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Mob Cats
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Transform into a funny villager kitty, or maybe a scary zombie cat, or maybe even a creeper kitty. Join the mob and unleash your inner feline adventurer! Get ready to pounce into action with Mob Cats!

- 5 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Howdy
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Step into the wild with Howdy! Where cowboy charm meets fun exploration! Our skin packs are designed for those who appreciate the beauty of the wilderness and the simplicity of country life. Bring a touch of the ranch to your everyday with our western-inspired theme!

- 10 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: ENTITY
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Introducing ENTITY, a thrilling set of skins inspired by spooky internet tales. This pack brings a world of horror and fun to your game with 10 unique designs, each one bursting with eerie charm. Step into the shoes of mysterious figures and creepy creatures that roam the blocky shadows.

- 10 HD Skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: CREATURES
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These creatures have big claws, large eyes and sharp teeth. Become a creepy cave creature and scare other players!

- 9 skins

items.title: Japanese Fashion
items.creator: Loose Screw
items.description:
Spice up your wardrobe with these Japan fashion inspired fits. 

- Total of 10 skins
- Great for roleplay!
- By Loose Screw

items.title: Duck Friends
items.creator: Dalibu Studios
items.description:
Waddle into style with Duck Friends! Join a group of fun-loving friends dressed in cozy duck-themed outfits-cute hoodies, playful hats, and charming accessories. Whether you're exploring, building, or just hanging out, you'll always look duck-tastic!

- Get ready to quack up your Minecraft adventures!
- 10 Skins

items.title: Dinosaurs Add-On
items.creator: Block Perfect Studios
items.description:
This Jurassic-themed Add-On brings Dinosaurs to any world! Don't just run and hide... tame, ride & equip dinosaurs with epic craftable weapons for any and every battle!

- 20 Dinosaurs and their baby versions (super cute).
- Hatching, taming, riding and fighting.
- Multiplayer friendly.
- Spawn rule settings.,
- Add-On by Block Perfect Studios

items.title: Knights
items.creator: DeliSoft Studios
items.description:
Arm yourself for glory with Knights! This legendary collection features 12 noble and battle-ready characters, each inspired by the age of chivalry, honor, and epic quests.

- DSS Designed arms and legs
- Medieval and armored themes
- 12 skins ready to defend the realm
